title: 第3章 换剑阁
content_zh:
第3章换剑阁
楚梁的额前缓缓冒出一个小问号，他不由得说道：“师尊，玉剑峰在诸峰之中势力最大，弟子近百人，其中成名的金丹境都有几个，他们夺得首席的几率确实最大。而弟子我……前几日才突破神意境啊。”
首席弟子是蜀山每一代的门面担当，这样的人物竞争激烈自然不必说。
而诸峰首座，则是三十六峰主之中威望最重、实力最强的人。在四大镇山长老不能成为掌教的情况下，可以说，诸峰首座是下一任掌教的第一顺位候选人。
而帝女凤……
可是出了名的蜀山一害，靠酗酒、能打、脾气暴名满江湖。当初她凭借着一身强悍修为硬是打出了个峰主之位，但是蜀山掌教一直不敢给她分配徒弟，生怕误人子弟。
最后还是她自己下山行侠仗义的时候捡回来个有修行资质的楚梁，这才收了个弟子，旁人也没法说什么。应该也是试过了才发现收徒这事并不好玩，她也再没收过第二个徒弟。
现在突然想要这一根独苗去竞争首席，还抢首座……连楚梁自己都有点惊讶。
她怎么敢想的啊？
接着就见帝女凤走过来，拍了拍他的肩膀，“你不用有太大压力，应该还有起码半年时间，好好准备就行……到时候要是真能拿到个首席，为师绝不会亏待你，你想要什么都好说……”
楚梁闻言，瞥了一眼帝女凤的胸口。
“噫——”帝女凤的眼神忽然变得危险起来，伸手指着他，“你想什么呢？”
“师尊你别误会。”楚梁道，“弟子是想说师尊已经压上了凰灵血玉这般至宝，弟子必然尽力准备，这是肯定的。只是……此事确实有一定难度，届时如果弟子失败，也希望师尊不要怪罪。”
“噢，看玉呢啊。”帝女凤摸了摸胸口的玉牌，嘿嘿一笑。
她又说道：“反正你当个事儿办就行，要是你成为首席弟子，为师我成了诸峰首座，都会有大量的资源倾斜……到时候，咱们师徒俩三七分账，岂不美哉……”
幻想着美好未来，她不由得发出了颤巍巍的笑声。
“桀桀桀桀桀……”
楚梁自阁楼中走出来，平复一下心情，就要去往自己的下一个目的地。
蜀山主峰，通天峰。
蜀山三十六峰之中，通天峰是掌教居住的无量宫的所在，同时也是类似于首都的地方，宗门的重要堂口都在上面。

楚梁一拈指诀，手环化作飞剑，咻的横在身前，将身踏上，须臾间剑光已离开银剑峰。
御剑飞行！
耳畔风声隆隆作响，脚下是白茫茫的无垠云海，三十六峰从云海中露出或巍峨或奇峻的峰头，就像在火锅汤中翻滚的食材。
道道流光在群山之间穿梭，都是匆匆来回的蜀山弟子，不会飞的人在这里是寸步难行。偶有几只灵禽仙兽呼啸而过，驾驭剑光的弟子们都要纷纷避让。能养得起这些大家伙当坐骑的，就算不是峰主、长老级别的长辈，也多半是背景不俗，万一擦着碰着可就犯不上了。
在蜀山派内部，弟子需要替山门完成任务才能换取日常生活和修行所需的资源。而这个领取任务的地点，就是“换剑阁”。
在修仙界，金银珠宝对大部分修者来说都是没有意义的。所以江湖上流通的货币，通常是用于锻造和冶炼的灵石、辅助修行的丹药、用途广泛的符箓等等一般等价物。
这其中，灵石是最硬通的。
所以蜀山内部，也将灵石铸造的钱币作为宗门的货币。最早期，制造工艺相当粗糙，就是直接将灵石磨成圆形削成两半，当时按形状称为“馒头币”。
但馒头币太过简单，很快就有弟子自行仿作劣质馒头币，造成不良影响。于是宗门改进工艺，将灵石雕刻成繁复精致的蝴蝶状，称为“蝴蝶币”。
可蝴蝶币的问题在于，工艺太过复杂，量产出现困难，宗门稍微发展又供应不上。最后还是当时的蜀山掌教想了个办法，将灵石做成简单的小剑形状，再注入一丝特别的剑气，这样就工艺简单且无法仿制。
之后数千年，蜀山使用的都是这种“剑币”，这也是“换剑阁”名字的由来。
换剑阁，二层。
气势恢宏的换剑阁其实只有三层，只是面积大、穹顶高，显得格外气派。大多数事务都是招的执事弟子在办，但每天也有几位执事长老在楼上坐镇，一些难题还是要他们出马。
楚梁就来到了其中一名长老的静室。
“沈老，又来搅扰您了。”他一进屋，就微笑打招呼道。
“哈，小楚啊。”屋内是一名宽袍大袖的老者，身材富态，有些秃顶，但气质出尘，笑容可掬，“打扰什么，这么快就回来了，看来上次那个任务完成的很顺利啊？”
“托您老的福，还算顺利，今天就是来交差的。”楚梁答道。
“行，那先不急，先来一盘再说。”沈老大袖一挥，身前案上已然出现一副棋盘，两壶棋子，黑白分明。
“上次侥幸赢了沈老一局，看来您是不服气啊。”楚梁毫不推拒，径直坐下笑道。
“那是自然，我回去琢磨了许久，已经找到破你局的法子了。”沈老先落一子。

“那还是老规矩，您老如果输了，可得给我透露点内幕消息。”楚梁一脸乖巧道。
半个时辰后。
日光上移稍许。
面带微笑的少年将双手笼在袖子里，看着对面盯着棋盘苦思冥想的老人，“沈老，确实是死局。”
“嘶……”沈老挠挠自己光滑的头顶，又瞄了几眼，才将目光拔出来，摇摇头，道：“你这小子……看着时时面带笑容、一脸人畜无害的样子，棋盘上却是步步杀招、子子如刀，当真一个果决狠辣……”
“嗨，不过是运气罢了，中间有几次我也险些崩盘。”楚梁道。
“哎呀，老咯……比不得你们年轻人的锐气。”沈老身子向后一仰，拍了拍肚皮，又道：“你来除了交任务，也是想领新任务是吧？”
“是啊，只不过神意境的任务是最多的，成百上千不知如何挑选。”楚梁道。
“我想想啊……你喜欢除妖的任务，比较好的……”沈老略一沉吟，便抬起手来，后方一排签筒中一下飞出一支签，落在他的掌心，“那你看看这个吧。”
楚梁接签，只见上面一行小字。
“邢州城明员外府捉妖。”

Chapter 3 Changing Sword Pavilion
A small question mark slowly appeared in front of Chu Liang's forehead, and he couldn't help but say: "Master, Jade Sword Peak is the most powerful among the peaks. There are nearly a hundred disciples, among whom there are several who are famous in the Golden Core Realm. They have the greatest chance of winning the top spot. As for my disciple... I just broke through to the Divine Realm a few days ago."
The chief disciple is the face of every generation in Shushan. It goes without saying that competition among such figures is fierce.
The leader of the peaks is the person with the most prestige and strength among the thirty-six peak masters. In the case where the four major mountain-holding elders cannot become the headmaster, it can be said that the leader of the peaks is the first candidate for the next headmaster.
And the Emperor's daughter Phoenix...
But the notorious Shushan is a disaster, and he is famous all over the world for his drunkenness, ability to fight, and bad temper. Back then, she had managed to gain the position of peak master with her strong cultivation, but the headmaster of Shushan had never dared to assign a disciple to her, for fear that he would mislead someone.
In the end, when she went down the mountain to perform chivalry, she picked up a Chu Liang who had the qualifications to practice. Then she accepted a disciple, and no one else could say anything. She must have tried it before she realized that taking on a disciple was not fun, and she never accepted a second disciple.
Now he suddenly wants to compete for the top spot with this single seedling, and grab the first place... Even Chu Liang himself is a little surprised.
How dare she think that?
Then Emperor Daughter Feng came over and patted him on the shoulder, "You don't have to be too stressed. You should have at least half a year to prepare well... If you can really get a chief position by then, I will never treat you badly as a teacher. You can say whatever you want..."
When Chu Liang heard this, he glanced at the chest of the emperor's daughter Feng.
"Hey -" Emperor Nvfeng's eyes suddenly became dangerous, and she pointed at him, "What are you thinking about?"
"Master, please don't misunderstand." Chu Liang said, "The disciple wants to say that the master has already pressed for a precious treasure like the Phoenix Spirit Blood Jade, and the disciple will do his best to prepare. This is for sure. However... this matter is indeed difficult. If the disciple fails, I hope the master will not blame him."
"Oh, look at the jade." Emperor Daughter Feng touched the jade plaque on her chest and smiled.
She added: "Anyway, you can just take care of it. If you become the chief disciple and I become the leader of all the peaks, a lot of resources will be allocated... At that time, we, the master and the apprentice, will divide the accounts 30-70, wouldn't it be wonderful..."
She couldn't help but let out a shaky laugh as she dreamed of a better future.
"Jiejiejiejiejie..."
Chu Liang walked out of the attic, calmed down his mood, and was about to go to his next destination.
The main peak of Shushan Mountain is Tongtian Peak.
Among the thirty-six peaks of Shu Mountain, Tongtian Peak is where the Infinite Palace where the leader lives is located. It is also a place similar to the capital, with all the important entrances of the sect on it.
Chu Liang made a gesture with his fingers, and his bracelet turned into a flying sword. He placed it horizontally in front of him and stepped on it. In an instant, the sword light had left Silver Sword Peak.
Sword flying!
The wind is rumbling in my ears, and beneath my feet is the boundless white sea of ​​clouds. The thirty-six peaks are towering or steep peaks protruding from the sea of ​​clouds, just like the ingredients tumbling in the hot pot soup.
The streams of light shuttle between the mountains, all of them are Shushan disciples hurriedly going back and forth. People who can't fly can't move here. Occasionally, a few spiritual birds and beasts roared past, and the disciples who were wielding the sword light had to get out of the way. Those who can afford to keep these big guys as mounts, even if they are not peak masters or elders, most of them have a good background, so they will not fall into trouble if they encounter them.
Within the Shushan Sect, disciples need to complete tasks for the sect in order to exchange for resources needed for daily life and practice. The place to receive the mission is "Changing Sword Pavilion".
In the world of cultivating immortals, gold, silver and jewelry are meaningless to most cultivators. Therefore, the currencies circulating in the world are usually spiritual stones used for forging and smelting, elixirs to assist cultivation, talismans with various uses, and other general equivalents.
Among them, spiritual stones are the mostHard pass.
Therefore, within Shushan, coins cast from spirit stones are also used as the currency of the sect. In the earliest days, the manufacturing process was quite crude, that is, the spirit stone was directly ground into a round shape and cut into two halves. At that time, it was called "mantou coin" based on its shape.
But the steamed bun coins were too simple, and soon some disciples imitated inferior steamed bun coins on their own, causing adverse effects. So the sect improved its craftsmanship and carved the spiritual stone into a complicated and exquisite butterfly shape, which was called "Butterfly Coin".
But the problem with butterfly coins is that the process is too complex, making mass production difficult, and the sect cannot supply enough even if it develops slightly. In the end, the headmaster of Shushan at the time came up with a way to make the spirit stone into a simple sword shape and inject a special sword energy into it, so that the craftsmanship was simple and impossible to imitate.
For thousands of years, this kind of "sword coin" was used in Shushan, which is also the origin of the name "Changing Sword Pavilion".
Changing Sword Pavilion, second floor.
The majestic Sword Changing Pavilion actually only has three floors, but its large area and high dome make it particularly grand. Most of the affairs are handled by the deacon disciples recruited, but there are also several deacons and elders sitting upstairs every day, and they still need to solve some problems.
Chu Liang came to the quiet room of one of the elders.
"Mr. Shen, I'm disturbing you again." As soon as he entered the room, he greeted with a smile.
"Ha, Xiao Chu." Inside the room was an old man with a wide robe and long sleeves. He was well-built and somewhat bald, but had an outstanding temperament and a charming smile. "Why bother you? You're back so soon. It seems that the last mission was completed smoothly?"
"Thanks to you, everything went smoothly. I'm just here to deliver a business today." Chu Liang replied.
"Okay, don't worry, let's play a game first." Boss Shen waved his sleeves, and a chessboard and two pots of chess pieces appeared on the table in front of him, clearly black and white.
"I was lucky enough to win against Mr. Shen last time. It seems you are not convinced." Chu Liang did not refuse, sat down and smiled.
"That's natural. I went back and thought about it for a long time, and I have found a way to break your game." Mr. Shen made the first move.
"That's still the old rule. If you lose, you have to reveal some inside information to me." Chu Liang said with a sweet look on his face.
Half an hour later.
The daylight moves up slightly.
The smiling young man put his hands in his sleeves and looked at the old man opposite who was staring at the chessboard and thinking hard, "Mr. Shen, this is indeed a dead end."
"Hiss..." Mr. Shen scratched the smooth top of his head and glanced a few more times before pulling out his eyes, shaking his head and saying: "You kid... you look like a harmless person with a smile on your face all the time, but on the chessboard there are killer moves every step of the way, and the pieces are like knives. You are really decisive and ruthless..."
"Hey, it's just luck. I almost collapsed a few times." Chu Liang said.
"Oh, old man... I can't compare to the spirit of you young people." Old Shen leaned back, patted his belly, and said: "In addition to handing in tasks, you also want to take on new tasks, right?"
"Yes, it's just that the missions of the divine realm are the most numerous. There are hundreds of them and I don't know how to choose." Chu Liang said.
"Let me think about it...you like the task of exterminating demons, which is better..." Shen Laolue pondered, then raised his hand, and a lottery ticket flew out of the row of lottery tubes behind him and landed in his palm, "Then take a look at this."
Chu Liang took the signature and saw only a line of small words on it.
"Xingzhou City Ming Yuan is out to catch monsters."
